articles.title: The 21st Century's 10 Best Serious Roles Played By Comedy Actors
articles.summary: Comedy is an underrated and challenging skill for actors, highly subjective with polarizing characters. Viewers either find comedic types endearing or annoying, making consistent appeal difficult. Successfully navigating this requires actors to deeply understand audience perception and skillfully portray roles that resonate broadly, effectively overcoming the inherent challenge of subjective humor.

articles.title: AEW Collision Review: Maya World Shocks Athena in Houston
articles.summary: This article reviews the recent AEW Collision event from Houston, focusing on significant wrestling outcomes. It details Maya World's surprising victory over Athena and Ciampa's intense bout against Jericho, which left Jericho bloodied. The report provides a recap of the show's most impactful moments and match results, appealing to wrestling enthusiasts interested in specific event highlights and key rivalries.

articles.title: Rajnath Singh leads 1,000 soldiers in Yoga day celebrations at Eastern Air Command, Shillong
articles.summary: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh spearheaded the 12th International Day of Yoga (IDY) celebrations, leading personnel from the Defence Forces and the Ministry of Defence in performing yoga. This initiative highlighted the crucial importance of physical and mental well-being and discipline for service members. It underscores the defence community's commitment to holistic health, ensuring personnel are robust and resilient.

articles.title: 22.7 lakh students appear for NEET re-test amid AI, CCTV and biometric vigil
articles.summary: The NEET-UG re-examination was successfully conducted on Sunday, ensuring a glitch-free process for 22.7 lakh students. This critical medical entrance test took place across 5,440 centres in India and 14 international locations. The smooth conduct provides a fair opportunity for aspirants pursuing medical careers, marking a significant national educational milestone.
